_comment: Baseline snapshot of approve/disapprove counts for Unsolicited Opinions. The live source of truth is Abacus (namespace 'stefanolambiase-unsolicited-opinions', keys '<opinion-id>-approve' / '<opinion-id>-disapprove'). The site reads from Abacus at runtime and falls back to the values in this file if Abacus is unreachable. Update this file occasionally by visiting https://abacus.jasoncameron.dev/get/stefanolambiase-unsolicited-opinions/<key> for each key, copying the value here, and committing. Also bump 'lastUpdated' when you do.
